author: reek
body: A distribution check on deck-shuffle. Nothing in the tree had one: the existing CardDeck tests assert that a shuffle returns the right number of cards and that the same cards are still present, which a shuffle that does nothing also satisfies.

author: reek
body: Two measurements, because the failure hides from the first one alone.

author: reek
body: deck-shuffle mutates: fy-swap uses list-set-at, which writes in place and returns the same list. So every trial builds a fresh deck rather than reusing one, or trial two would shuffle trial one's result.

author: reek
body: Shuffle an eight-card deck once per seed and tally where card 0 landed.

author: reek
body: A two-card deck has exactly two outcomes. Over consecutive seeds a fair shuffle changes its mind about half the time; a stripe changes it every time.
